name: Bloodforged elite mob drops a rare and a non-Heroic epic
contract: Requires Bloodforged.Enable = 1, PvpPower.Enable = 1, Bloodforged.Rates55 = "0.00 99.99 0.00", Bloodforged.EliteEpicPercent = 100, Bloodforged.HighRiskEliteEntries = "1834", Bloodforged.EliteHeroicUpgradePercent = 0, Bloodforged.DropRate.Rare and .Epic = 1, Bloodforged.ExtraBluePercent = 0 and the catalogue SQL with its Heroic Bloodforged entries. A level 60 High-Risk character kills a natural Scarlet Paladin (elite, level 55-56, listed as a High-Risk elite) in Western Plaguelands and finds exactly two Bloodforged items: the guaranteed rare roll and the elite epic, which is a normal (not Heroic) epic copy.
